section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews literature on early affiliative experiences, social safeness, body appreciation, and eating psychopathology. The authors discuss how positive early relationships and social safeness promote adaptive emotion regulation and well-being, while negative experiences are linked to psychopathology and disordered eating. The section concludes by stating that the current study aims to test an integrative model exploring how recall of early warmth and safeness memories impact eating psychopathology through social safeness and body appreciation, noting that no prior studies have explored this specific model.
